Rashi on Ketubot 73b:10:1.hebrew: מאי לאו טעות נדרים - שהתנה עמה על מנת שאין עליה נדרים, והטעתו שהיו עליה נדרים, וכן למומין ולכל תנאי שיתנה. וקאמר ת"ק: אם בעלו קנו. אלמא, איכא למ"ד אפילו בתנאי לא בעיל איניש אדעתא דתנאה, דמסיק אדעתיה דלמא לא מיקיים והויא בעילת זנות:
Rashi on Ketubot 73b:10:1.english: What, is it not an error [concerning] vows - That he stipulated with her on condition that there are no vows upon her, and she deceived him [in] that there were vows upon her, and similarly regarding blemishes and any condition that he may stipulate. And the Tanna Kamma says: If they had intercourse, they acquired [her]. Thus, there is one who says [that] even with a condition, a man does not have intercourse relying on the condition, because he bears in mind [that] perhaps [the condition] will not be fulfilled and it will be an act of promiscuous intercourse.

Rashi on Ketubot 73b:11:1.hebrew: לא טעות פחות משוה פרוטה - דטעה בקדושין, דסבר שמקדשין בכך. ועלה קאמר "אם בעלו קנו", דאדם יודע שאין קדושין בפחות משוה פרוטה, וגמר ובעל לשם קדושין. אבל בטעות תנאי לא מסיק אדעתיה לבעול לשם קדושין, שסומך עליה: "אם לא שתנאה קיים, לא היתה ניסת לי לחופה":
Rashi on Ketubot 73b:11:1.english: No, [it is] an error [regarding] less than the value of a perutah - For he erred in the betrothal, as he thought that one can betroth with such [an amount]. And regarding this [case], [the baraita] states: "If they cohabited, they have acquired [her]," because a person knows that there is no betrothal with less than the value of a perutah, and [therefore] he resolved and cohabited for the sake of betrothal. However, in an error regarding a condition, it does not enter his mind to cohabit for the sake of betrothal, because he relies on her, [thinking,] "If her condition were not fulfilled, she would not be married to me under the chuppah."

Rashi on Ketubot 73b:12:1.hebrew: במאי קמיפלגי - לדידך דאמרת דלאו בתנאה פליגי, במאי פליגי גבי פחות משוה פרוטה? מאי טעמא דר"ש:
Rashi on Ketubot 73b:12:1.english: With regard to what do they disagree - According to you, who say that they do not disagree regarding a condition, with regard to what do they disagree concerning less than the value of a peruta? What is the reason of Rabbi Shimon [ben Yehuda]?

Rashi on Ketubot 73b:13:1.hebrew: בכולהו גרסינן, "והא הכא דטעות אשה אחת היא":
Rashi on Ketubot 73b:13:1.english: In all of them, we read [the text]: "And here, it is a mistake [concerning] one woman."

Rashi on Ketubot 73b:13:2.hebrew: והא הכא דכי טעות אשה אחת דמי - דזו שהטעתו היא שהתנת עמו ולא גרשה בינתיים, ואיכא למ"ד מקודשת. וטעמא מאי? לפי שאין אדם עושה בעילתו זנות, וגמר ובעל בלא שום תנאי:
Rashi on Ketubot 73b:13:2.english: But here, it is similar to a mistake [concerning] one woman - For this [woman] who misled him is the one who stipulated with him, and he did not divorce her in the meantime, and there is one who says [that] she is betrothed. And what is the reason? Because a man does not make his intercourse [an act of] licentiousness, so he resolved and engaged in intercourse without any condition.

Rashi on Ketubot 73b:15:1.hebrew: מודים חכמים לרבי אליעזר - ביבמות תנן: המגרש את האשה והחזירה ומת, מותרת ליבם, ור"א אוסר. והתם מפרש טעמא דר"א, דגזר משום יתומה בחיי האב. והיא המפורשת כאן, שהודו לו חכמים בה:
Rashi on Ketubot 73b:15:1.english: The Sages concede to Rabbi Eliezer - In Yevamot we learned [in a Mishnah]: One who divorces his wife and remarries her and dies — she is permitted to the levir, and Rabbi Eliezer forbids [her]. And there [the Gemara] explains Rabbi Eliezer's reason: that he decreed [a prohibition] on account of an orphan in her father's lifetime. And this is the [case] specified here, regarding which the Sages conceded to him.

Rashi on Ketubot 73b:15:2.english: And she was divorced - And her father received her bill of divorce.

Rashi on Ketubot 73b:15:3.hebrew: והיא יתומה בחיי האב - אף בחיי אביה היא כיתומה, לפי שיצאה מרשותו מנשואין הראשונים, ושוב אין לו זכות בה לקבל קידושיה:
Rashi on Ketubot 73b:15:3.english: And she is an orphan in the lifetime of the father - Even during her father's lifetime she is like an orphan, because she left his authority through the first marriage, and he no longer has the right over her to accept her betrothal.

Rashi on Ketubot 73b:15:4.hebrew: והחזירה - בקטנותה, ומעשה קטנה אינו כלום:
Rashi on Ketubot 73b:15:4.english: And he remarried her - During her minority, and the act of a minor is nothing.

Rashi on Ketubot 73b:16:1.hebrew: שגירושיה גירושין גמורים - ונאסרה עליו איסור כרת מחמת גרושת אחיו, שהתורה אמרה ערות[אשת] אחיך וגו':
Rashi on Ketubot 73b:16:1.english: That her divorce is a full-fledged divorce - And she became forbidden to him [by] a prohibition [punishable by] karet on account of [being] his brother's divorcée, for the Torah states, "The nakedness of your brother's wife," etc.

Rashi on Ketubot 73b:16:2.english: And her return is not a full-fledged [return] - to return and be his brother's wife where there is a mitzvah to enter into levirate marriage.

Rashi on Ketubot 73b:17:1.english: Either she performs chalitzah or she enters into levirate marriage - For her remarriage is a complete remarriage, [such that she is] a brother's wife.

Rashi on Ketubot 73b:1:1.hebrew: לא קידשה סתם כו' - ומילתא באפי נפשה היא, ולקמיה פריך: מאי שנא גט ומאי שנא כתובה:
Rashi on Ketubot 73b:1:1.english: No, he betrothed her without specification, etc. - And it is an independent matter, and later [the Gemara] asks: What is different [about] a bill of divorce, and what is different [about] a marriage contract?

Rashi on Ketubot 73b:2:1.hebrew: ליתני כנסה סתם - בגוה ליכלליה וליתני הכי: המקדש על מנת שאין עליה נדרים וכנסה סתם כו':
Rashi on Ketubot 73b:2:1.english: Let [the Mishnah] teach: He married her without specification - Within it, let it include [this case] and teach thus: One who betroths [a woman] on condition that there are no vows upon her and marries her without specification, etc.

Rashi on Ketubot 73b:2:2.hebrew: וכ"ש - בלא כנסה, אבל השתא משמע דדווקא בשלא כנסה קאמר:
Rashi on Ketubot 73b:2:2.english: And all the more so - [in this case] without having married her; but now, it implies that [the Mishnah] is speaking specifically of when he did not marry her.

Rashi on Ketubot 73b:3:1.hebrew: הכי נמי קאמר - דהאי "ונמצאו עליה" דקתני, לאחר שניסת קאמר:
Rashi on Ketubot 73b:3:1.english: That is also what he is saying - That this [phrase,] "and [vows] were found upon her," which [the Mishnah] teaches, he is saying [about a case] after she was married.

Rashi on Ketubot 73b:4:1.hebrew: דאמר אי אפשי כו' - ואע"ג דלא אתני, כמאן דאתני דמי:
Rashi on Ketubot 73b:4:1.english: Because he says: I do not want, etc. - And even though he did not stipulate [this], it is as though he had stipulated [it].

Rashi on Ketubot 73b:4:2.hebrew: גט נמי לא תיבעי - דהא שמואל לית ליה "אין אדם עושה בעילתו זנות", כדאשמועינן גבי קטנה:
Rashi on Ketubot 73b:4:2.english: She should also not require a bill of divorce - For Shmuel does not hold [the principle that] a man does not make his intercourse [an act of] licentiousness, as he taught us regarding a minor girl.

Rashi on Ketubot 73b:5:1.hebrew: ספוקי מספקא ליה - על סתם אדם, אם אפשי באשה נדרנית אם לאו:
Rashi on Ketubot 73b:5:1.english: [The tanna] is uncertain - regarding an ordinary person, whether [he says], "I want a woman who makes vows," or not.

Rashi on Ketubot 73b:5:2.hebrew: גבי ממונא לקולא - דהמוציא מחבירו עליו הראיה, וכיון דמספקא לן, לא גביא:
Rashi on Ketubot 73b:5:2.english: Concerning monetary matters, [rule] leniently - For [the principle is that] the burden of proof is upon the one who seeks to extract [payment] from his fellow, and since we are in doubt, she does not collect [her ketubah].

Rashi on Ketubot 73b:6:1.english: The dispute - of Rav and Shmuel.

Rashi on Ketubot 73b:6:2.hebrew: בטעות שתי נשים - קידש לאה על תנאי, ואשה אחרת כנס סתם אחריה, ונמצאו עליה נדרים והיינו טעותא. רב סבר: כיון דלא אתני בהדה דהך, אע"פ שכבר גילה דעתו שאי אפשי בנדרנית, צריכה הימנו גט — דלמא לגבה דהך חביבה עליה ולא קפיד. ושמואל אמר: כיון דגלי דעתיה, גלי:
Rashi on Ketubot 73b:6:2.english: In [the case of] an error [concerning] two women - He betrothed Leah on condition [that she had no vows], and another woman he married without specification after her, and vows were found upon her — and this is the error. Rav holds: since he did not stipulate with this one, even though he already revealed his mind that "I do not want a woman with vows," she requires a bill of divorce from him, [for] perhaps with respect to this one she is dear to him and he is not particular. And Shmuel says: since he revealed his mind, he revealed [it].

Rashi on Ketubot 73b:6:3.hebrew: אבל בטעות אשה אחת - קידשה על תנאי וכנסה סתם, אפילו רב מודה דדעתיה אתנאיה:
Rashi on Ketubot 73b:6:3.english: But in [the case of] an error [concerning] one woman - [Where] he betrothed her on condition and married her without specification, even Rav agrees that his intention was on his condition.

Rashi on Ketubot 73b:7:1.hebrew: והא מתניתין דטעות אשה אחת היא - למאי דסלקא דעתין דסיפא ארישא קאי, טעות אשה אחת היא, וקא מותבינן מינה לעיל; אלמא, איכא דסבירא ליה דטעות דאשה אחת נמי צריכה גט. ואע"ג דאנן הוא דאותבינן, ולאו רב איירי בה, קושיא היא לרבה — דהאי "דברי הכל" דקאמר, סברא דידיה היא, ולאו מרב ושמואל שמעה, שהרי לא היה בדורם, אלא דקסבר ליכא למאן דאמר בכי האי גוונא דלאו דעתיה אתנאיה; והא קא חזינן דכל בני מדרשא דאותבוה סלקא דעתין למימר הכי:
Rashi on Ketubot 73b:7:1.english: But the Mishnah [is a case of] an error [concerning] one woman - According to what we initially assumed, that the latter clause refers to the first clause, it is [a case of] an error [concerning] one woman, and we raised an objection from it above. Thus, there is [an opinion] that holds that [in a case of] an error [concerning] one woman, she also requires a bill of divorce. And even though it is we who raised the objection [from it], and Rav did not speak about it, it is [nonetheless] a difficulty for Rabbah — for this "everyone agrees" that he stated is his own reasoning, and he did not hear it from Rav and Shmuel, since he was not in their generation; rather, he reasoned [that] there is no one who says in such a case that his intent was not on his condition, yet behold, we see that all the members of the study hall who raised the objection to him thought to say so.

Rashi on Ketubot 73b:8:1.hebrew: מחלוקת בטעות אשה אחת כעין שתי נשים - קידשה על תנאי, וגירשה מן האירוסין, וחזר וכנסה סתם. בההיא אמר רב: צריכה גט, דכי אשה אחרת דמי, ולשם קדושין בעל, וליכא למימר אתנאיה קמא סמיך. ושמואל סבר: הא גלי לה דעתיה מעיקרא, דאם היא נדרנית אי אפשי בה, ועל תנאי כך חזר וקידשה:
Rashi on Ketubot 73b:8:1.english: The dispute is with regard to an error [concerning] one woman similar to two women - [If] he betrothed her on a condition, and divorced her from betrothal, and then went back and married her without specification — in that [case], Rav says she requires a bill of divorce, for it is like [the case of] another woman, and he cohabited for the sake of betrothal, and one cannot say that he relied on his first condition. But Shmuel holds: Behold, he revealed his intent to her from the outset, that if she is subject to vows, "I do not want her," and it was on that condition [that] he went back and betrothed her.

Rashi on Ketubot 73b:8:2.hebrew: אבל בטעות אשה אחת גרידתא - שכנסה ע"י קדושין הראשונים, דברי הכל כו'. וכי אותבינן לעיל ממתני', הכי אותבינן: מאי לאו קידשה על תנאי וכנסה סתם משגירשה, דבלא גירשה ליכא למאן דאמר, והיכא דגירשה מיהא קתני כתובה לא בעיא, הא גיטא בעיא. ואני שמעתי: טעות אשה אחת כעין ב' נשים — כגון שקדש רחל על תנאי, ואח"כ נתכוין לכנוס לאה, וכנסה סתם ונמצאת רחל. וקשיא לי: נהי נמי דנתכוין לבעול לשם קידושין, הא לאו לרחל איכוין, ואמאי צריכה גט:
Rashi on Ketubot 73b:8:2.english: But in [the case of] a simple error [concerning] one woman - where he married her on the basis of the first betrothal, everyone [agrees], etc. And when we raised an objection above from the Mishnah, this is how we raised it: "Is it not [speaking of a case where] he betrothed her conditionally and married her without specification after he divorced her" — since without having divorced her, there is no one who says [she requires a bill of divorce] — "and where he did divorce her, at any rate, it teaches [that] she does not require a ketubah, [implying that] she does require a bill of divorce." And I heard [another explanation of] "an error [concerning] one woman similar to two women": for example, where he betrothed Rachel conditionally, and afterward intended to marry Leah, and he married her without specification and she turned out to be Rachel. And this is difficult for me: even though he intended to have intercourse for the sake of betrothal, he did not intend [it] for Rachel — so why does she require a bill of divorce?

Rashi on Ketubot 73b:9:1.hebrew: קידשה בטעות - קס"ד טעות נדרים, כדמפרש ואזיל:
Rashi on Ketubot 73b:9:1.english: He betrothed her in error - It was initially assumed [that this refers to] an error [concerning] vows, as [the Gemara] proceeds to explain.

Rashi on Ketubot 73b:9:2.hebrew: קטן - אין קדושיו כלום, דלאו בר קיחה הוא; "כי יקח איש" כתיב [דברים כב]:
Rashi on Ketubot 73b:9:2.english: A minor - His betrothal is nothing [i.e., has no validity], for he is not capable of "taking" [a wife in marriage], [as] "When a man takes" is written [Deuteronomy 22].

Rashi on Ketubot 73b:9:3.hebrew: אע"פ ששלח סבלונות - אכולה קאי:
Rashi on Ketubot 73b:9:3.english: Even if he sent gifts - [This] refers to all of them.

Rashi on Ketubot 73b:9:4.english: Sivlonot - Delicacies that the groom sends to his betrothed.

Rashi on Ketubot 73b:9:5.hebrew: אינה מקודשת - ואע"פ ששלח משהגדיל, ולא אמרי' ניהוי סבלונות קידושין, לפי שמחמת קידושין הראשונים שלח לשם סבלונות ולא לשם קידושין:
Rashi on Ketubot 73b:9:5.english: She is not betrothed - Even though he sent [them] after he became an adult, and we do not say [that] the presents should be [considered] betrothal, because on account of the original betrothal he sent [them] for the sake of presents and not for the sake of betrothal.

Tosafot on Ketubot 73b:12:1.hebrew: אדם יודע שאין קידושין כו' - הך צריכותא הו"מ למימר לעיל, כי פריך: "והא איפליגו בה חדא זימנא":
Tosafot on Ketubot 73b:12:1.english: A person knows that betrothal [does not take effect] etc. - This [explanation of] necessity could have been stated earlier, when [the Gemara] asked: "But they already disagreed about this once!"

Tosafot on Ketubot 73b:13:1.hebrew: והא הכא דכטעות אשה אחת דמי כו' - תימה לר"י: כיון דמדמי קידושי קטנה לטעות, א"כ תקשי ליה נמי ברייתא דלעיל דוכן קטן שקידש דפליגי אע"ג דהוי בטעות אשה אחת? וי"ל דקטן שקידש ניחא ליה — כיון דאין קידושי קטן כלום אפי' מדרבנן, בועל לשם קדושין; אבל קידושי קטנה דרבנן דמי טפי לקידושין בתנאי. אבל תימה: לפי מאי שאינו יודע עתה שום חילוק בין קידש על תנאי לקידושי קטנה, תקשי ליה דרב אדרב, דאמר לעיל גבי קטנה שלא מיאנה דבעל לשם קידושין, אף על גב דהוי כטעות אשה אחת! ושמא לא שמיע ליה ההוא פלוגתא דקטנה שלא מיאנה:
Tosafot on Ketubot 73b:13:1.english: But here it is similar to a mistake [concerning] one woman, etc. - It is astonishing to the Ri [Rabbi Yitzchak]: since [Abaye] compares the betrothal of a minor girl to an error [in betrothal], if so, let the baraita above of "and similarly a minor [boy] who betrothed" — where they disagree even though it is [a case of] an error [concerning] one woman — also pose a difficulty for him! And one can answer that [regarding] a minor [boy] who betrothed, it is satisfactory to him — since the betrothal of a minor [boy] is nothing at all, even by rabbinic law, he engages in intercourse for the sake of betrothal; whereas the betrothal of a minor girl, [which is valid] by rabbinic law, is more similar to betrothal on a condition. However, it is astonishing: since [Abaye] does not currently know of any distinction between one who betrothed on a condition and the betrothal of a minor girl, let [the statement of] Rav [contradict that of] Rav for him, for [Rav] said above regarding a minor girl who did not exercise refusal that he engaged in intercourse for the sake of betrothal, even though it is like an error [concerning] one woman! And perhaps [Abaye] had not heard that dispute regarding a minor girl who did not exercise refusal.
